hooks.name: Block secrets from being committed or written
hooks.description: Scans saved files for private keys, API secrets, and wallet keys. Blocks if found.

action.command: grep -nE "(0x[a-fA-F0-9]{64}|PRIVATE_KEY\s*=\s*0x|sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,})" "$KIRO_FILE_PATH" && echo "SECRETS DETECTED in $KIRO_FILE_PATH" >&2 && exit 2 || exit 0
